This is a transaction-topology defect; the frozen _source_delta05 equality and exact-nine guards are operating as designed.

The chosen repair restores the successful BF20 topology: preserve the exact predecessor acquisition/intervening closure as the first segment, create a private acquisition base with all nine typed paths at verified BEFORE/absence bytes, then create a child source commit that applies exactly the nine tested AFTER blobs. The design keeps the real worktree and ledger untouched and requires actual CAS/index/HEAD guards.

The typed nine are independently listed and hash-bound. The design keeps their nine-file segment separate from the reviewed 618-file closure and explicitly handles both modified paths and the newly added pin path whose BEFORE state is absence.
